## Summary
Sameera Bhanu builds responsive, high-performance web applications with semantic HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and React. She creates custom design systems including Neumorphic (Soft UI) and tactile interfaces, interactive canvas visualizations (FlowField particle wind), and 3D card physics (CardStack).

## Core Technical Skills
- Frontend Core: HTML5 (Semantic Structure, Accessibility, ARIA), CSS3 (Flexbox, CSS Grid, Custom Properties, Keyframe Animations), JavaScript (ES6+, Async/Await, DOM APIs, Event Delegation)
- Frameworks & Libraries: React, Kokonut UI component adaptations, FontAwesome, Canvas API
- Design Systems & Styling: Neumorphism (Soft UI dual shadows), Skeuomorphic tactile design, Mobile-first Responsive Design
- Development Tools: Git, GitHub, Browser DevTools, VS Code, REST APIs, LocalStorage
